title: User – response
description: POST /users (201; 200 for a repeated id), GET and PATCH /users/{id}, PUT /users/{id}/pin, POST /sites/{id}/users (200). The user as sync pull delivers it to the caller: site_ids limited to the caller's sites, the PIN fields only to the site phone. Error responses use api/error.json.

pin.description: Only when the server generated the PIN: no other response shows it, except a replay of the same request with the same Idempotency-Key within 24 hours (see common/idempotency-key.json); a repeated create with the same id does not return it. Tell it to the user.
